## Live replacement

**Live file swap: static only.** live_link op=hotswap: finds the current seg04 copy byte-exact in 8 MB RDRAM (BE or word-swapped), writes the new seg04 + seg17, repoints graph-node DL words, verifies, frame check, reverts on fail; tested on fakes only

**Pick whip: partial.** pick_identify backend 'sm64' always answers Mario (no object projection) and locates his stock seg04 byte-exact in RDRAM; pick_replace -> live_link hotswap on RetroArch, else build

**Live controls:** live_link op=push / hotswap (Blender Live Link and pick_replace's SM64 route); cheats op=add; no SM64 sliders

## Gaps before a live swap / pick whip

- RDRAM hot swap has only fake-adapter tests (tests/test_live_link_identity.py); no in-game proof
- Only Mario is a slot; pick does not project other objects, so the whip cannot target anything else
- Hot swap needs the session's current seg04 to match the previous build or vanilla exactly; another build or save state means relaunch
- Boot-screen Goddard head writer not implemented
- Writer offsets are the PAL NSMP ROM's; a real US ROM is refused by check_rom
